name: Google Maps
what_it_does: Maps, transit routing, reviews, live delays
revenue_model: Local search ads + Maps Platform API fees
gap_we_fill: Knows where, not what it means: no day-level plan repair, no etiquette, no local hosts

name: Google Translate / Lens
what_it_does: Text, voice and camera translation (~250 languages)
gap_we_fill: Translates words, not context: no 'why', no manners, no plan

name: Japan Official Travel App (JNTO)
what_it_does: Route search, spot articles, ATMs/Wi-Fi, safety alerts
gap_we_fill: Information, not a personal plan; no booking, no hosts, no stress-test

name: NAVITIME Japan Travel
what_it_does: Transit routes, travel plans, articles, disaster info
gap_we_fill: Transit-first: no whole-day repair after a delay, no culture hosts or exchange

name: Klook
what_it_does: Tickets, passes, tours, eSIM, transport passes
revenue_model: Commission (15-35% to suppliers); ~16.7% take rate (2024 rev/GTV)
gap_we_fill: A catalogue, not a plan: no disruption handling, no etiquette layer, takes up to 35% from hosts

name: GetYourGuide
gap_we_fill: Western-first catalogue; no Japan etiquette, no plan, host keeps only 70-80%

name: Viator (Tripadvisor)
gap_we_fill: Same as GYG: one booking at a time, no live-trip help

name: Tripadvisor
what_it_does: Reviews, rankings, AI trip ideas, bookings via partners
gap_we_fill: Reviews are opinions about places, not a plan that survives the day

name: Wanderlog
what_it_does: Collaborative itinerary + map, budget, Gmail import
gap_we_fill: Static plan: breaks on the first delay; not Japan-specific; no culture

name: Airbnb Experiences
gap_we_fill: One experience, not the trip; no etiquette, no measurement of exchange

name: VoiceTra (NICT)
gap_we_fill: Translation only, needs data; no trip context

name: Safety tips (JTA)
gap_we_fill: Alerts only: doesn't re-plan your day or call help in your language

name: Trip.com
what_it_does: Flights, hotels, rail, attractions; strong for China inbound/outbound
gap_we_fill: Big OTA: books logistics, not culture; no on-the-ground repair

name: byFood
what_it_does: ~300 Japan food experiences, cooking classes, food tours
gap_we_fill: Food only; proves demand for local hosts (good partner, not threat)

name: MagicalTrip
gap_we_fill: Single tours; no plan, no app-level help

name: ChatGPT / Mindtrip / Layla
scale: 54% of travellers used AI to plan (vendor-commissioned survey)
gap_we_fill: Can invent places, no live data, no bookings, no hosts; we only use verified places

name: Trip DNA (us)
what_it_does: Plan → stress-test → repair · translate · book · culture companion · local hosts · SOS
revenue_model: Commission 10-15% + partner subs + Trip Pass + guide/meetup fees + ads
gap_we_fill: Everything verifiable in one place, and it measures cultural exchange
